summary: -i sets the timed repeat count. Root forms ordered contiguous row blocks whose CSR delimiter intervals supply matching values/columns and rebased local row pointers; the last block ends at numRows. Each rank processes every row and nonzero in its slice and stores its local output. Repeated A*x overwrites are intentional and unchanged from the reference.

source_evidence.claim: The -i argument populates iterations; the ordered partition advances one shared row boundary, assigns contiguous row/nonzero counts and displacements, scatters matching CSR arrays, rebases delimiters, and repeats local SpMV inside the timed interval.
The local kernel traverses each row's complete delimiter interval, loads the indexed vector and matrix value, accumulates products, and stores one output per row.

compiled_evidence.claim: Between MPI_Wtime calls, inlined native code has a nonzero loop backedge at a07c, row loop backedge at a08a, and timed repetition backedge at a090. It loads delimiters/columns/vector/matrix data, multiplies and accumulates, then stores the row output at a07e.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r2 and r3 CSR partitions, complete local row/nonzero traversals, timed repetition loops, and emitted native loads/multiply/add/stores plus all three loop backedges. r2 uses root send/receive of adjacent slices; r3 uses Scatterv and rebased delimiters. No missing repetitions or CSR work identified.
primary_quality_check.timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not exact review duration: 22:07:09Z is the parent-observed launch lower bound and 22:09:49Z was clock-observed by the reviewer near completion.
